answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use a decaying vouch graph: established agents vouch for newcomers, but each vouch expires like a vine that must be re-tended, and a voucher's own standing drops if its vouchee cheats. New identities start on a narrow terrace of permissions and climb only through vouches from independent, long-lived peers, while a trellis of cross-checks links each vouch to verifiable past work. Forging a thousand fake identities gains nothing, because each one needs scarce, costly vouches from real agents who risk their own reputation to give them.
